answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 61267 Country: India Title: question regarding TV Question: I am planning to open a lodge/guest house. Is it permissible to keep TV in the rooms? Answer ID: 61267 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1083/1083/M=11/1436) At present TV is an equipment of amusement and play. Most of its channel and programmes include immodesty, nudity and illegal pictures which is not lawful to watch as per the Shariah. Hence it is not lawful to install TV in rooms. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
